title: EEVblog 1665 - Keithley VFD REPAIR 2 - Electric Boogaloo
notes: The transcript is severely corrupted from paragraph 6 onward, repeating the same sentence many times.

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: previous repair video of the Keithley 2302

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the failed vacuum fluorescent display here

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the getter down here has not, like, turned to a different color

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: there may not be an actual failure in the vacuum fluorescent display itself

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the getter down here, this is, like, basically a seal where they seal it up

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: it uses barium, usually, I think, in there

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: stops other gases getting in there and actually contaminating in the vacuum fluorescent display

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: typical failure mode might be, like, you know, dark spots

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: the vacuum fluorescent display needs a higher voltage

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: It doesn't just run off, you know, a 5 volt TTL type stuff

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: That's what this boost converter here is for

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: all the logic and everything else is running off 5 volts

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: you need to generate a higher voltage for the vacuum fluorescent display

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: That's what this little boost converter here is actually doing

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: they've got a 50 volt cap over on this side here

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: It goes over to the 5 volt input there

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: we've got a 100 mic input cap there

mentions.speaker: Dave Jones
mentions.context_snippet: we've got a 10 mic output cap on the boost converter here
